title: Pulse
description: A boy (Joey Lawrence) tries to warn his father (Cliff De Young) and stepmother (Roxanne Hart) about their unsafe household appliances.

title: Runaway
description: Two police officers (Tom Selleck, Cynthia Rhodes) of the future hunt a bad batch of robots programmed to kill by a madman (Gene Simmons).

title: The People Across the Lake
description: A couple (Valerie Harper, Gerald McRaney) and their children move to the country, where they open a shop and find dead bodies.

title: Solo
description: A robot soldier (Mario Van Peebles) goes AWOL to avoid reprogramming, then helps Mexican villagers defeat rebels.

title: Krull
description: A prince (Ken Marshall) needs a razor-tipped boomerang to free his beloved (Lysette Anthony) from the fortress of the Beast.

title: Blue Thunder
description: A Los Angeles police pilot (Roy Scheider) commandeers a helicopter equipped with snooping gadgets and trick weapons.

title: Conspiracy
description: A former Marine (Val Kilmer) brings justice to a small town after his friend mysteriously disappears.

title: All the King's Men
description: A Southern politician's (Sean Penn) idealism and good intentions give way to corruption after he becomes governor of Louisiana.

title: Guarding Tess
description: A Secret Service agent (Nicolas Cage) is reassigned to protect a defiant former first lady (Shirley MacLaine) at her Ohio home.

title: Robot and Frank
description: An aging, cantankerous ex-cat burglar finds his zest for life renewed when he trains his robotic caretaker to help him commit heists.

title: The Principal
description: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up.

title: Desperate Measures
description: To save his terminally ill son, a San Francisco policeman (Andy Garcia) arranges for a sociopathic killer (Michael Keaton) to donate bone marrow.

title: Gloria
description: A street-toughened woman (Sharon Stone) goes on the run with a 7-year-old boy (Jean-Luke Figueroa) whose parents were killed by mobsters.

title: Crossroads
description: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson.

title: White Water Summer
description: An outdoor guide (Kevin Bacon) leads a city boy (Sean Astin) and three peers on a program to toughen them up.

title: Final Descent
description: A pilot (Robert Urich) and co-pilot (Annette O'Toole) have limited options to land a jumbo jet after a severe midair collision.

title: Final Run
description: A man (Robert Urich) tries to stop a computerized train that is speeding out of control and headed for a large hospital.

title: Miracle on the Mountain: The Kincaid Family Story
description: Injured when their private plane crashes into a snowy mountain, a domineering man (William Devane) and his family (Patty Duke, Elisabeth Rosen) face an avalanche and bitter winds.

title: Awakenings
description: A doctor (Robin Williams) tries the drug L-dopa on an immobile man (Robert De Niro) and others like him in 1969 New York.

title: Julie & Julia
description: A woman in Queens, N.Y., sets a deadline of one year to prepare all 524 recipes in Julia Child's famous cookbook, "Mastering the Art of French Cooking."

title: Eat Pray Love
description: Facing a crossroads in her life, a divorcee (Julia Roberts) travels to Italy, India and Bali on a quest to change her life and find true happiness.

title: Brian's Song
description: Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) of the Chicago Bears befriends his teammate Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher), who is dying of cancer.

title: The Nines
description: An actor is under house arrest, a TV show chronicles a sitcom production, and a video-game designer and his family become stranded in the woods.

title: Agnes of God
description: A psychiatrist (Jane Fonda) probes the mind of a nun (Meg Tilly) in whose room has been found a dead newborn infant.

title: Touch the Top of the World
description: Climber Erik Weihenmayer becomes the first blind person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

title: Buddy
description: An animal lover raises a baby gorilla in the 1920s Brooklyn, along with a slew of geese, dogs, horses and chimps.

title: The Master of Disguise
description: A genial waiter (Dana Carvey) tries to rescue his parents from a criminal mastermind by assuming various identities.

title: Sunset
description: Tom Mix (Bruce Willis) and Wyatt Earp (James Garner) solve a murder mystery at the Academy Awards in 1929 Hollywood.

title: No Mercy

title: The Principal

title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
